name: Purpose Of The Church
overview: The church is established by Christ as a steadfast spiritual community, built on the foundation of His authority that no opposition can overcome (Matthew 16:18). Its primary purpose is to make disciples of all nations through teaching and baptism in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19). The early church devoted itself to apostolic doctrine, fellowship, prayer, and communion (Acts 2:42), forming a unified household of God where believers are fellow citizens with the saints (Ephesians 2:19). Furthermore, the church reveals God's manifold wisdom to spiritual realms (Ephesians 3:10) and is equipped by Christ with apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to build up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11).
